qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of the Manual Task Service driver implementation guide?
qa_pairs.output: The Manual Task Service driver implementation guide provides information about configuring and using the Manual Task Service driver for NetIQ Identity Manager, helping administrators understand the concepts and implement a secure, distributed administration model.

qa_pairs.instruction: Who is the intended audience for the Manual Task Service driver guide?
qa_pairs.output: The intended audience for the Manual Task Service driver guide are individuals responsible for understanding administration concepts and implementing a secure, distributed administration model within NetIQ Identity Manager.

qa_pairs.instruction: Where can you find additional documentation for the Manual Task Service driver?
qa_pairs.output: For more information about the Manual Task Service driver, you can visit the Identity Manager documentation website at https://www.netiq.com/documentation/identity-manager-47/ and the Identity Manager drivers documentation website at https://www.netiq.com/documentation/identity-manager-47-drivers/.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you contact Technical Support for issues with the Manual Task Service driver?
qa_pairs.output:
To contact Technical Support for the Manual Task Service driver, use the following information:
- Worldwide: www.netiq.com/support/contactinfo.asp
- North and South America: 1-713-418-5555
- Europe, Middle East, and Africa: +353 (0) 91-782 677
- Email: support@netiq.com
- Web Site: www.netiq.com/support

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you provide feedback on the Manual Task Service driver documentation?
qa_pairs.output: To provide feedback on the Manual Task Service driver documentation, click the "Add Comment" link at the bottom of any HTML version of the documentation page on www.netiq.com/documentation, or email Documentation-Feedback@netiq.com.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the key resources and contacts provided in the Manual Task Service driver implementation guide.
qa_pairs.output: The Manual Task Service driver implementation guide points users to the Identity Manager documentation site and the drivers documentation site for more details. It lists contact information for Sales Support, Technical Support, and Documentation Support, including phone numbers, email addresses, and web URLs, and encourages feedback via an online comment feature or email.
